case_policy: All validated laps in the first source file for four fixed recording labels, plus all eight GT7 laps; fastest lap in each source is a deterministic reference. Self checks separated. No rejection is hidden.

runtime.scope: cold deterministic engine including geometry, ambiguity audit, both projections and all KPIs; no browser rendering

reference.boundary_policy: Verified (0,T) timing anchors with <=100 ms source coverage and <=20 m spatial margin; no duration/time normalization
reference.progress_policy: Projection onto common reference; <=3 m jitter drawdown regularized by running maximum
reference.stationary_policy: Repeated progress preserves arrival/departure dwell; internal boundary uses right-continuous departure
reference.repeated_position_interpretation: Includes stationary observations, projection plateaus and boundary anchoring; not an independent vehicle-stop detector

analyzed.boundary_policy: Verified (0,T) timing anchors with <=100 ms source coverage and <=20 m spatial margin; no duration/time normalization
analyzed.progress_policy: Projection onto common reference; <=3 m jitter drawdown regularized by running maximum
analyzed.stationary_policy: Repeated progress preserves arrival/departure dwell; internal boundary uses right-continuous departure
analyzed.repeated_position_interpretation: Includes stationary observations, projection plateaus and boundary anchoring; not an independent vehicle-stop detector

quality.method: Sequential segment projection onto the same reference XY; nonlocal-branch ambiguity audit

reconciliation.interpretation: Numerical reconciliation to witnessed lap timing anchors, not independent validation of sub-section alignment accuracy
